startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description:
Pages to capture, e.g. eBay item or seller pages. Any http(s) URL works.

Any eBay marketplace works — ebay.com, ebay.es, ebay.de, ebay.co.uk, ebay.com.au and so on. The capture stays on the domain you give it: the page is rendered in that site's language and currency, the anti-bot warm-up hits that same domain, and the proxy exits in that country. URLs are used exactly as provided — no query parameters are added or removed.

urls.title: URLs (plain list)
urls.description: Alternative to Start URLs - a plain list of URLs. Both fields are merged and de-duplicated.

fullPage.title: Full page screenshot
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of just the viewport. Lazy-loaded images are triggered by scrolling first.

waitMs.title: Extra wait (ms)
waitMs.description: Settle time after the page is ready, before the screenshot is taken. The readiness checks already wait for content to render, so this is only a safety margin.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of pages captured in parallel. Keep it low to avoid anti-bot blocks.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max retries
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times a failed page is retried before it is reported as an error.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max requests per run
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Safety cap on how many pages a single run may capture, retries included. Prevents a huge URL list from consuming the whole budget.

maxHeightPx.title: Max screenshot height (px)
maxHeightPx.description: Cap the captured height of full-page screenshots. 0 captures the whole page. An eBay item page is often ~12000px tall but the listing itself ends around 4000px - capping there is much faster and cheaper, and usually the more useful image.
